long_biography.plain_text:
Fred and Frances Bondy settled in Dothan after buying Malone Motor Company, laying the foundation for the automotive retailer that took their name. Frances worked in the enterprise for more than four decades and was its president when she died in 2015.

Their daughter Renate was married to David Hall Marshall for fifty-four years. He later owned dealerships representing Ford, Lincoln, Nissan, Toyota and Kubota. The company stayed in the family through another generation. Their son Fred is now identified as owner of the Dothan Ford store, whose business history dates to 1970.
